messages:
tessa_support: Escalating to CS — ClearSight (trial) reporting intermittent 500s + long tail latency on embeddings during their final integration run. They say this blocks pilot sign-off next week. Marked P1.

 tessa_support: Repro summary: bulk upload ~3.8k docs via sync API; errors start ~40-60s in. Error example: `HTTP 500 {\"error\":\"internal_server_error\", \"trace_id\":\"tr-9f3b\"}` and some `HTTP 429` during retries. No deploys in last 72h.

 harry_cs: Thanks — POC is nina@clearsight.ai, pilot kickoff 2026-10-04. This is a conversion risk. Recommend immediate customer note + short-term workaround and eng bridge.

 leena_csm: Draft comms: "Hi Nina — were investigating degraded embedding performance. Short-term: please switch to the async batch endpoint and limit parallel workers to 2. We can also apply a one-time quota uplift while we diagnose. Engineering will provide a mitigation within 6 hours and an RCA within 72 hours. We'll join a bridge to walk through steps." Approve? :white_check_mark:  

 tessa_support: Approve. Add CLI snippet and exact conf: ```BATCH_SIZE=64 WORKER_CONCURRENCY=2 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d @batch.json -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>"``` Also suggest exponential backoff with jitter.

 infra-bot: autoscaler: no recent scale events. Monitoring notes spike in embed-pool memory at 2026-09-28T14:11Z.

 drew_eng: Looking at router logs: gateway token exhaustion followed by KV-cache allocation failures. Hypothesis: retry storm + large batch parallelism causing cache churn. Quick mitigations: (1) tenant quota bump for 24h, (2) ask customer to use async path + lower concurrency, (3) test `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8` in staging. I can run tests — ETA 4h for staging verification, 24h for cautious prod canary if all green.

 harry_cs: I'll schedule a 30-min bridge with Nina within 2 hours and lead customer comms. Leena — please add renewal-risk flag and offer a one-week trial extension if they want reassurance.

 leena_csm: Adding renewal flag now and drafting the extension offer. Keep notes concise so I can paste to leadership.

 tessa_support: Action items recap: (1) send immediate workaround + CLI (harry_cs) due now; (2) eng staging test + knob validation (drew_eng) ETA 4h; (3) ops temp quota bump if safe (infra-bot) pending eng; (4) RCA draft (drew_eng) due 72h.

 drew_eng: Running staging repro. If KV pressure confirmed I'll try `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8` and a gateway smoothing change.

 infra-bot: holding manual headroom request pending eng verification.

 harry_cs: Bridge scheduled 2026-09-28 15:30 PT. Invited @drew_eng, @tessa_support, @leena_csm. Sending pre-brief and runbook now.

 tessa_support: Update 2026-09-28T15:05Z — sent customer note and runbook. Customer applied concurrency=2 and started again; initial error rate decreased but some retries remain. Nina is looking for timeline and assurance before pilot.

 drew_eng: Staging results: reproduced memory pressure and KV-cache churn under parallel prefix loads. `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8` reduced OOMs by ~87% in staging. Preparing a small prod canary plan and rollback criteria (error rate >2% sustained).

 infra-bot: recommended temp tenant_quota=320 for tenant=clearsight (24h) if eng signs off.

 harry_cs: After bridge: Nina appreciated the fast response and accepted the temporary measures. She asked for the full RCA before the pilot. I scheduled a post-canary check-in 2026-09-29 09:00 PT.

 drew_eng: Will coordinate prod canary with ops for a 6-hour window tomorrow morning. If canary is green I'll post a short RCA and long-term remediation list (trial guardrails, autoscaler headroom defaults, telemetry for retry storms).

 leena_csm: Please include suggested customer-facing wording in the RCA so I can attach to renewal communications.

 tessa_support: Final short-term owner recap: customer comms + runbook (harry_cs), staging/prod canary + RCA (drew_eng), renewal note + trial-extension offer (leena_csm). Keep updates short for exec summary.

 drew_eng: Quick status 2026-09-28T18:20Z — canary plan submitted. Posting results and RCA to this thread after rollout.

 harry_cs: Thanks team — excellent cross-functional response. I'll follow up with Nina and confirm post-canary check-in. :thumbsup:
